summary: It might be a Paine, but you have to learn some Common Sense. How else would you Locke in and secure your natural rights by declaring your independence? Enlightenment philosophy and religion inspired colonial belief in individual liberty and republican government, ideas which later became ingrained into the foundational documents of America.
